prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production animation pose atlas, not a storyboard or illustration board.
Input images 1 and 2 are ONLY character identity, costume, materials and lighting REFERENCES from the approved PIXEL CLASH cinematic scene designs. Preserve that exact adult Korean female archer, long near-black silky half-tied hair, ivory fitted jacket, red right shoulder, blue left sleeve, leather bracers, navy trousers, graphite/silver recurve bow and cream-fletched slim arrow. High-fidelity realistic game cinematic, NOT pixel art, NOT low-poly, no new outfit or face.
Create ONE SQUARE image, ideally 3072x3072, with a PRECISE 3 columns x 3 rows grid of NINE separate transparent-background animation key poses. NO grid lines, borders, text, labels, shadows on a background, scenery or checkerboard. GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. Each pose must stay entirely inside its own equal square cell with ~10% empty margin. All nine identical-size women are seen from the SAME rear three-quarter camera as the desktop BOW DRAW reference, aiming toward image RIGHT. Keep the pelvis center and lower-body baseline at the SAME pixel position in every cell; head size and costume details constant. Frame from head to mid-thigh, keep the ENTIRE bow including both tips, both hands, all hair, quiver and arrow within each cell. Do not mirror any frame.
Read order left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
0: rear idle, bow down slightly angled forward, both hands relaxed.
1: left arm begins lifting bow to chest height, right hand reaches arrow/string; hair slight breeze.
2: bow lifted to shoulder aiming height, left arm extends, right elbow begins moving backward, arrow nocked but string only lightly pulled.
3: correct right-handed archery, left hand grips bow forward, right hand draws string to halfway toward jaw, right elbow rotates back.
4: draw nearly complete, right hand near cheek/jaw, bent recurve limbs increase tension; arrow on bow rest.
5: full tension, right hand anchors exactly at jaw, right elbow back, head absolutely steady, taut string triangle; ONE arrow nocked pointing image right.
6: RELEASE: string snaps forward to relaxed bow, arrow is GONE from this cell; right fingers relaxed and hand follows backward along cheek toward ear. A few hair strands start flying backward.
7: release follow-through, right hand now just behind ear, LEFT arm still holding bow forward; silky hair streams diagonally backward, ONE bow only, NO arrow.
8: follow-through settling, hair begins easing back, shoulders relax slightly, bow still mostly up, no arrow.
The changing ARM JOINTS, BOWSTRING TENSION, BOW FLEX and HAIR are essential: these must be genuinely different anatomical poses, not the same image moved or rotated. Maintain character anatomy and all non-moving costume/hair details consistently, with correct hands and two arms. No duplicates, extra weapons, logos or watermark. Soft cream/amber rimlight and cool navy fill matching references. Exactly nine isolated poses, same scale, same camera, same baseline. Transparent alpha.

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production MOBILE animation pose atlas.
Input images 1 and 2 are character/costume/light continuity REFERENCES; use the MOBILE rear-view composition, not the desktop side view. Same exact adult Korean woman, long half-tied silky near-black hair, ivory jacket/red right shoulder/blue left sleeve, black leather bracers, navy pants, recurve graphite/silver bow, cream-fletched dark arrow. High fidelity realistic game cinematic, no pixel art.
Create ONE square PNG with a PRECISE 3x3 grid of exactly nine equal-sized isolated animation poses on GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. No lettering, grids, borders, shadows, scenery or checkerboard. SAME camera, SAME head size, SAME pelvis position, SAME baseline in all nine cells. All figures seen FROM BEHIND, like the mobile reference, aiming AWAY from the viewer slightly toward the upper-right into depth, NOT sideways across the frame. Frame head to mid-thigh; leave comfortable clear margins so complete bow tips, hands, hair and quiver do not touch cell edges.
Read order row-major:
0 rear idle bow lowered, long hair down back.
1 left arm lifting bow, right hand starts reaching the nock, small hair sway.
2 left arm reaches forward/upward aiming height, right elbow starts pulling string back, arrow nocked.
3 half draw: left hand forward holding grip, right elbow sideways/back, right draw hand approaching jaw.
4 nearly full draw: right fingers anchor near cheek, taut string.
5 full tension: right hand at jaw, elbow back, head steady, one arrow nocked downrange, bow visibly flexed.
6 release: string relaxed/snapped forward, arrow GONE, right hand follows back to ear, left arm still forward. Hair starts whipping diagonally.
7 follow-through: right hand behind ear, hair flows leftward/diagonally inside cell, no arrow.
8 settling: same release stance relaxing slightly, hair easing back, no arrow.
These must show genuinely changing arm angles, bow flex/string geometry and hair pose while preserving the exact person. One bow per cell, two coherent hands/arms, no duplicate arrows, no skin holes, no flat pasted photographic background. No red/green fringes or colored cutout halos. Clean fine hair alpha edges, natural ivory rim light, navy/amber fill consistent with references. Exactly NINE full contained poses.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: approved 01 / REAR VIEW two-panel desktop/mobile cinematic board. This is a background plate for animation.
Preserve the whole board's exact dimensions, panel rectangles, camera angles, arena architecture, moon, torch bowls, far pillars, spectator tiers, wet stone floor, banners, dark navy/amber atmosphere, original lighting and perspective.
Remove ONLY the woman, hair, clothes, bow, hands, arrows and quiver from BOTH frames, reconstructing the believable empty shooting lane behind them. Also remove the circular target and wooden stand downrange from BOTH frames, reconstructing the stone lane and original distant archway. There must be NO human foreground silhouette, NO bow, NO target or stand in either panel. Tiny far spectators can remain as the existing background.
Keep a clean empty shooting lane with dramatic depth, wet stone reflections, soft low ground haze. Empty foreground where the figure stood. The large left frame is the desktop camera, the right frame is the independently composed elevated portrait camera. Do NOT crop the desktop to make the portrait, do NOT add a new scene or new architecture. Keep original fine material detail and realistic high-end game-cinematic look.
Remove all external lettering, including "01 / REAR VIEW", "DESKTOP 16:9", "MOBILE 9:16", leaving the same charcoal board surround. Preserve the TWO image panel positions and proportions exactly, with only narrow dark gutters. No new text, no watermark, no pixels or logos.

Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: isolated animated prop, realistic archery target with stand.
Input image 1 is the approved scene 04 BULLSEYE HIT design reference. Derive the SAME original target, painted ring palette, cracked canvas/wood texture, circular restrained metal/wood rim, small bolts and wooden stand from that image.
Produce ONE large isolated target and full wooden stand on GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. NO arena, floor, mist, particles, labels, shadows outside the object, border or checkerboard. Realistic cinematic PBR-quality surface and soft cool/amber rimlight matching the original.
View it HEAD-ON, target face a geometrically centered true circle. Concentric gold/red/blue/black/cream rings in that order from center outward. Place the exact gold bullseye at the central horizontal axis. Target circle occupies the top ~70% of the square image, wooden stand continues to the bottom with full legs visible and margin around all edges. NO arrow embedded, NO impact hole, NO sparks, NO text. Repair the old center hole so the gold bullseye is clean. We will animate a separate arrow into the dead center. Do not redesign the target. Genuine alpha, crisp clean edges and no color-key halos.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: isolated projectile for cinematic animation.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND OBJECT reference: the single slim arrow in the approved BULLSEYE HIT shot.
Create ONE original realistic archery arrow, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha. Exactly horizontal, fletching and nock at LEFT, sharp metal arrowhead at RIGHT, complete arrow contained with margins. Long thin charcoal graphite shaft, small brushed-silver pointed head, cream/gold natural feather fletching like the reference. Same scale and realistic material character as the scene designs, not a fantasy sword, not a spear. Soft cream rimlight, fine shaft and feather detail. No motion trails, no target, no hand, no archer, no floor, no shadows, no grid, no caption, no logo, no watermark. One arrow only. A wide landscape asset, the arrow long but elegant and physically thin. Transparent background.
